entities.name: PMID:25072953
observations: Pilot cross-sectional study of 141 postmenopausal women without renal dysfunction or hypertension; evaluated estimated GFR, carotid/femoral intima-media thickness, and arterial plaques.

entities.name: Low GFR and atherosclerosis
observations: Among 141 apparently healthy postmenopausal women, lower estimated GFR within normal limits independently associated with higher carotid bulb IMT (β=-0.212, P=0.020) and femoral IMT (β=-0.293, P=0.001); higher GFR above the 25th percentile associated with lower odds of carotid bulb plaque (OR=0.146, P=0.006). Cross-sectional pilot evidence does not establish causality.
